script_text: Your coding agent ships fast. It also ships ugly. I'm Charles. Army vet. I build software with AI agents, in public. This is ASV Labs. Independent software, made with intent. A handful of apps. One of them is open right now. It's called Motif. A design library your agent calls over MCP. Guidance, tested templates, design checks. Connect it once. One command, sign in with an email code. Then just ask in plain English. It builds. Then it checks its own work. Contrast, touch targets, line length. Fixes what fails. This studio site was built by an agent following Motif. The studio's fake. The build is real. Free trial, no card. Link's in the caption. Follow ASV Labs. You'll see the wins and the faceplants.
